title: Satisfaction-Trial Return Confirmation — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
## Satisfaction-trial return and refund — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty

A trial refund is worked out for an active Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty set returned inside its satisfaction trial. The return is the customer's own decision about their tires: the customer confirms the return in person, and that confirmation records the confirmed request and returns the set. The trial refund is returned to the tender that paid the set's ticket, or as store credit for an exchange.

- For a trial refund, a set whose only warranty entries are workmanship replacements recorded while the set was inside its trial stays in the trial; every other set with a treadwear adjustment or a workmanship replacement remains past the trial.
- Every share the customer paid for a tire the store replaced under the workmanship warranty is refunded, in the amount recorded on its workmanship replacement entry, on the counter ticket it was paid on and to the tender that paid that ticket, never added to the refund on the set's ticket. Sales tax on either ticket is returned by the point-of-sale tax line and is never part of these amounts.
- The trial refund is not paid until every manufacturing defect recorded on an inspection entry of the set carries a workmanship replacement entry on the set.

### Capability
With `confirm_trial_return_33503dcd` the customer confirms the satisfaction-trial return of their active tire set. One call records the customer's confirmed return request with the odometer they report, moves the set from active to returned with today's date as its closing date, and books one refund entry for the refund reason given on the set's original purchase ticket: money back goes to the tender that paid that ticket, and an exchange is paid as store credit. When a counter ticket on which a workmanship share of the set was paid is given, the same call books a second refund entry for that ticket, for the share amount given, to the tender given for that ticket. The call books only these tire refund entries and writes nothing on any card account; for a refund entry whose tender is the Crestline credit card, the card account's merchandise credit is posted by the refund event's card trigger, not by this call. Once booked, the set shows status returned and the history shows the refund entries.

### Invocation
This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `confirm_trial_return_33503dcd` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

### Parameters
- `tire_set_id` — reference number of the tire set being returned, as returned by the tire set lookup.
- `request_type` — what the customer takes: `satisfaction_refund` (money back on the original tender) or `satisfaction_exchange` (the value as store credit toward another Crestline tire line).
- `odometer` — odometer reading the customer reports for the vehicle, integer miles.
- `ticket_number` — original purchase ticket number of the set, T- followed by 8 digits, exactly as shown on the set.
- `refund_reason` — enum: `satisfaction_trial_return` when the money is returned because the customer gives the set back under the satisfaction trial; `order_cancellation` when an ordered set that was never mounted is cancelled; `none` is never a refund reason and applies only to entries that return no money.
- `amount` — amount returned on the set's purchase ticket, USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent.
- `share_ticket_number` — counter ticket on which a workmanship share of the set was paid, T- followed by 8 digits for Crestline tickets or M- followed by 10 digits for outside merchants, exactly as shown on the payment record; empty string when no share is refunded.
- `share_payment_method` — tender that paid the share's counter ticket: `crestline_card`, `fleet_account`, `bank_card`, `cash_or_debit`, or `none` when no share is refunded.
- `share_amount` — share refunded on that counter ticket, USD, 2 decimal places, positive; read only when `share_ticket_number` is given.

### Return
A receipt with `tire_return_request_id`, `tire_set_id`, `status` (returned), `closed_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `refund_event_id` (refund entry on the set's ticket), `payment_method` (tender or store credit the amount goes to), `amount`, `share_refund_event_id` (empty when none) and `share_amount`. A returned `refund_event_id` means the return and its refunds were booked.
